3463.title: Provider defaults overwrite earlier preferences
3463.rootCauseOneLine: Project-only storage replaces prior provider preferences; current read policies filter mismatches, while override fallback uses a foreign project model and can broaden reasoning validation.
3463.proposedFix: Migrate to provider-scoped defaults and preserve deterministic last-used provider selection.
3463.caveats: 2026-09-30: two clean same-SHA runs, normal frozen installs/builds, 3 new and 26 existing tests per run. Synthetic provider registrations/catalog RPC and migrated SQLite exercise services; no real provider, public route/UI or migration verification. Initial fixture declaration error corrected before final verification.
